Class LifetimeEntryManager

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics.Performance
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

Provides time-optimised updates for lifetime change notifications. This is used in specialised osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawables to optimise lifetime changes (see: osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.LifetimeManagementContainer).
